posts.author: TenDev
posts.body:
I made a mobile-focused on-screen GamePad plugin for RPG Maker that supports
true multi-touch
.
You can hold movement or an analog stick with one finger while pressing action buttons with another — inputs are processed simultaneously, not blocked like most existing mobile UI plugins.
Features include customizable on-screen buttons, an analog stick with diagonal movement, Base64 image support, scene-based visibility, and JavaScript conditions for showing or hiding buttons.
Download here
